summary: Robert Evans, Cody Johnston and Katy Stoll continue reading Ben Shapiro's 2016 novel True Allegiance, mocking its prose and its plot that casts racial profiling, a Texas invasion of Mexico and an anti-tax militia as heroic.

evidence.note: president berates the general over leaked illegal racial profiling of Muslims
protest leader takes over Detroit; later rewrites police hiring rules, framed as bad
Texas National Guard helicopters strike a cartel target in Ciudad Juarez
border closed to mothers and children; hosts compare the rhetoric to Trump's
novel's massacre of a migrant camp, including children, read aloud
fugitive anti-tax militia hit by a drone strike, described graphically
hosts note the novel came out about two months before the 2016 election

notes: Part of the multi-episode reading of True Allegiance; this story only covers the middle chapters. Time is the novel's 2016 publication and its unspecified near-present setting (approximate). Primary theme could be racism-white-supremacy or religious-right-culture-war; no theme fits right-wing polemical fiction exactly. Mexico setting is fictional (the invasion plot).
